STAGE 1 - scope and evidence check.
GOAL: confirm what the round requires and what evidence exists before proposing.
READ: the round brief in the prompt; the curvature report facts quoted in it (182 SID tables, standardised level-3 Ollivier curvature +0.26 with recall, level-1 -0.16, difference L1-L3 -0.20 p=0.0095, joint model curvature adds ~1pp over SID-quality R2=0.60, level-3 used-code count +0.42, collision rate -0.39); the earlier-round selected ideas list (poincare-frechet-successor-codebook, CURVCTRL-SID per-level curvature from hard prefix-transition score, BRad-RQ radius from transition-context entropy).
OBSERVED: the shared evidence directory is not readable from this sandbox (permission denied on /fs04/.../results/research/analysis_sid_recall/curvature/report.md); only the agent workspace is readable and it contains no copies. So the quantitative facts used are the ones stated verbatim in the brief.
REASONING: the binding constraints are (i) one run, no ablation arm, no sweeps, (ii) all three switches must exist in code, (iii) curvature must be a DESIGN TARGET that enters assignment, not a post-hoc predictor, (iv) Issue #127 collapse must be structurally impossible, not merely hoped away.
OPEN: which coupling position is still unoccupied (per-level curvature and radius-from-entropy are taken).

STAGE 2 - final answer produced (ORC-CELLCHART).
GOAL: pick a coupling position not used by earlier rounds and make it minimal-specifiable under one-run/no-ablation rules.
DECISION: per-CODE curvature magnitude for the Poincare chart used in the RQ-VAE nearest-code rule, set by the standardised Ollivier-Ricci curvature of that code's node in the level's training-transition quotient, expressed as a deviation from a resolution-matched (exactly K_l cells) behaviour reference partition built by rank-128 SVD + k-means on the training transition matrix. k_{l,c}=clip(k0 exp(-Phi_{l,c}), k0/4, 4k0), k0 from the 99th percentile residual norm; field refreshed every 5 epochs with EMA 0.9 and 20 size-preserving null shuffles; dead codes revived at k0/4 so K_l is never reduced (Issue #127 guard). Switches: behaviour off -> Phi=0 (uniform chart); geometry off -> Euclidean distance with the field computed but unused; both on -> trained once.
COST: <1% per step extra on the curved distance; ~600 refreshes at +3.3% step-equivalents plus 1-10 min of transport; one-off reference build <15 min; total +4-8% wall clock.
EVIDENCE: brief's curvature report facts only (shared dir not readable from this sandbox); no local copies.
OPEN: sign of the Phi->curvature map and the stability of smooth node curvature under a moving partition are the two things the single run must settle; diagnostics are recorded, only Stage3 test_recall@10 > 0.065 decides. Full text of the answer is in the final response, not stored here because it exceeded the 4000-character record limit.
